BE IT ORDAINED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE, WYOMING:
Section 1.That, pursuant to WYO. STAT.$15-7-407, the Board of Public Utilities
(BOARD") shall fix the rates forwater and sanitary sewer services furnished to customers, and anyrevision
thereof is subject to the governing body's review, modification and approval.
Section 2.That the BOARD is authorized by State Statute and City Code to set rates, fees and
penalties for water and sanitary sewer services furnished to customers to:
(a)Pay for the operation and maintenance of the water system, including salaries, wages
and benefits, and the cost of all materials and supplies necessary for repairs,
replacements and upgrades to the system;
(b)Pay interest charges and principal payments on all outstanding water loans and bonds as
they are due;
(c) Cover all miscellaneous expenses;
(d) Cover all usual extensions and enlargements, together with a reasonable allowance for
(e)Provide and maintain a depreciation fund for the water department.
Section 3.That the Board has determined that an increase in the water rates is necessary to
ensure adequate revenue is generated in order to pay for costs associated with those services rendered.
Section4.
That, pursuant to City Code Section 13.04.140, rates and charges for the
consumption f city utility services, har ges and fees for connections inspections penalties shut ff
penalties and meter installations shallbe established by theBOARD, approvedby the Governing Body and
filedwith the City Clerk andbusiness officeof the Board.
Section5.
That pursuant to City Ordinances 3975 adopted June10,2013, prior to the beginning
of eachfiscal year the BOARDwill calculate new ratesfor water and sewer services based on the Bureau of
Labor Statistics, Consumer Price Index, All Urban Consumers, Water and Sewer Maintenance and the
Wyoming Cost Living Index -Southeast Region and prepare new rate schedules for Water and Sewer
services.
Section 6.That the Bureau of Labor Statistics, Consumer Price Index, All Urban Consumers,
Water and Sewer Maintenance for the calendar year 2013 was 3.86%, the Wyoming Cost Living Index-
Southeast Region for the fourth quarter of 2013 was 3.4%, and the Engineering News Record
Construction Cost Index, from July 2012 to July 2013, was 3.40%.
Section 7.That the BOARD established by Resolution No.2014-04, adopted May 05,2014,
revised Water rates to be charged to users of the Cheyenne Water System as shown and set forth on the
resolution attached hereto as Exhibit A.
Section 8.That the BOARD established by Resolution No.2014-Q5, adopted May 05,2014,
revised Sewer rates to be charged to users of the Cheyenne Sewer System as shown and set forth on the
resolution attached here to as ExhibitB.
Section9.That the BOARD established by Resolution No.2014-, adopted May 05,2014,
revised Water and Sewer Connections Fees, System Development Fees, Pump Station Development
Fees, and Related Fees set by the Board of Public Utilities as shown and set forth on the resolution
attached hereto as Exhibit C.
Section 10.That the BOARD established by Resolution No.2014-07, adopted May 05,2014,
revised Administrative fees, Service charges and Penalties set by the Board of Public Utilities as shown and
set forth on the resolution attached hereto as Exhibit D.
Section 11.That the BOARD established by Resolution No. 2014-O, adopted May 05, 2014,
revised Septic Waste Dump and Commercial Waste Rates tobe charged to the user of the Cheyenne Water
and Sewer Systems as shown and set forth on the resolution attached hereto as Exhibit E.

Water Pump Station Development Fees:
For water connections issued within the designated Pump Station Water Service Area, the BOARD
will collect the Water Pump Station Development Fee according to the fee schedule.
For connections to the wastewater and/or the recycle water systems within the designated Pump
Station Service Area for those systems, the BOARD will collect a Water Pump Station
Development Fee according to the fee schedule.The PERMIT applicant, in lieu of having to
enlarge the pump station capacity, will paythisfee.
The applicant must pay the fee at the time thePERMIT is issued.(See attached map for Northwest
in the Northwest Cheyenne water service area.
The Pump Station Development Fee will also be paid for undeveloped lands and lots currently
annexed to the City of Cheyenne that have a restriction by theBOARD that the water pumpstation
capacity must be enlarged. ThePERMIT applicant, in lieu of having to enlarge the pump station
capacity, will pay this fee.
The following lands and lots located inside the Pump Station Service Water Area are exempt from
the pump station development fee:
1.
Lands and lots already annexed to the City of Cheyenne with no pump station
capacity enlargement restrictions by the BOARD.
2.
Lands and lots currently annexed or not annexed to the City of Cheyenne with a
restriction by theBOARD stating that the pump station capacity must be enlarged
by the owner and the pump station capacity has been enlarged to the BOARD's
satisfaction.
For connections to the wastewater and/or the recycle water systems that are served by a Pump
Station, the BOARD will collect a Water Pump Station Development Fee according to the fee
schedule. The PERMIT applicant, in lieu of having to enlarge the pump station capacity, will pay
this fee.

rates.

will be charged 1.5 times for all the above fees, charges and penalties.

water and sewer system users, basedupon the above rates for water and sewer connections, system
development fees, pump station development fees, and other related fees and that any revision of
the above rates shall be subject to Goverming Body review, modification and approval.
BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that the foregoing fees, charges and penalties established
by the BOARD be submitted to the City Council for approval and filing as provided by the Code
of the City of Cheyenne.

ENTITLED:"A RESOLUTION ADOPTING REVISED SEWER RATES TO BE CHARGED TO
USERS OF THE CHEYENNE SEWER SYSTEM."
WHEREAS, the Board of Public Utilities (“Board")is authorized by State Statute and City Code to set
rates, fees and penalties for water and sanitary sewer services furnished to customers to:
(a)Pay for the operation and maintenance of the sanitary sewer system, including salaries,
wages and benefits, and the cost of all materials and supplies necessary for repairs,
they are due;
(c) Cover all miscellaneous expenses;
(d) Cover all usual extensions and enlargements, together with a reasonable allowance for
(e)Provide and maintain a depreciation fund for the sewer department;
WHEREAS, the Board has determined that an increase in the sewer rates is necessary to ensure
adequate revenue is generated in order to pay for costs associated with those services;
WHEREAS, the Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne, pursuant to Ordinance 3975, adopted June
10, 2013, requires that prior to the beginning of each fiscal year, the Board will calculate new Sewer rates,
service charges, penalties and miscellaneous charges based on the Bureau of Labor Statistics, Consumer Price
Index, All Urban Consumers, Water and Sewer Maintenance and the Wyoming Cost of Living Index -
Southeast Region and prepare a new Sewer fee schedule;
WHEREAS, user chargesfor contributors shall bebased on requirements to adequately fund Operation
&Maintenance, Capital Equipment, Infrastructure replacement and improvement, and debt service
expenditures;
WHEREAS, residential user charges for contributors connected to city sewer may be based on the
user's average monthly water consumption as determined by watermeter readings taken in January, February
and Marchof each year or based on the actual metered water use each month;
WHEREAS, user charges for industrial and commercial contributors shall be based on water used each
month.If an industrial or commercial contributor uses water whichis not returned to the wastewater collection
meters installed and maintained at the contributor's expense, or any other method acceptable to the Board;
WHEREAS, the Bureau of Labor Statistics, Consumer Price Index, All Urban Consumers, Water and
Sewer Maintenance for the calendar year 2013was 3.86% and the Wyoming Cost of Living Index-Southeast
Regionfor thefourth quarter of 2013was3.4%;
WHEREAS, the2013Water and Wastewater Master Plan s recommend a5.5%adjustment to sewer
rates inorder to adequately fund Operation &Maintenance, Capital Equipment, Infrastructure replacement and
improvement, and debt service expenditures;
WHEREAS, the estimated construction cost of the Phase I Southern Sewer Interceptor Main Project is
$10,500,000 according to2013Water and Wastewater Master Plan s andasewer rate increase needed torepaya
$10,500,000 loan at 2.5% over 20 years is approximately $.31 per 1,000 gallons; and
improvements related to the PhaseI Southern Sewer Interceptor Main Project.
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED that the sewer rate schedule will be adjusted by
approximately 5.0% and by an additional $.11 per 1,000 gallons to pay for debt related to the Phase I Southern
Sewer Interceptor Main Project.

PUBLIC UTILITIES."
WHEREAS, the Board of Public Utilities ("BOARD") has exclusive authority to manage,
operate, maintain and control the Cheyenne Municipal Waterworks, Sanitary Sewage System and
Water Reclamation Facilities of the City and tomake all rules and regulations necessary for the
safe, economical and efficient operation and maintenance of the above facilities; and
WHEREAS, the Board has determined that an increase in the fees is necessary to pay for
costs associated with: the new connectors share of the water and sewer systems; water and sewer
development; water and sewer debt service; over-sizing certain water and sewer mains; and the
expansion to the water and sewer systems; and
WHEREAS, the BOARD desires to set the fees to secure an income sufficient to:
(a)Pay for costs associated with thewater and sewer installations;
(b）Recover costs and reduce debt associated with water and sewer development and
expansion for new connectors tothe City'swater and sewer system; and
(c)Pay for costs associated with the water and sewer over-sizing and extensions; and
WHEREAS, the Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne, pursuant to Ordinance 3975,
adopted June 10, 2013, requires that prior to the beginning of each fiscal year, the Board will
calculate new tap (connection)fees, system development fees, pump station development fees,
and other related fees based on the Bureau of Labor Statistics, Consumer Price Index, All Urban
Consumers, Water and Sewer Maintenance and the Wyoming Cost of Living Index-Southeast
Region and prepare a new fee schedule for the tap (connection) fees, system development fees,
pump station development fes, and other related fees; and
WHEREAS, the Bureau of Labor Statistics, Consumer Price Index, All Urban
Consumers, Water and Sewer Maintenance for the calendar year 2013was 3.86%and the
Wyoming Cost of Living Index -Southeast Region for the fourth quarter of 2013 was 3.4%; and
WHEREAS, the 2013 Water and Wastewater Master Plans include a recommendation
that adjustments to Connection and System Development Fees should include a provision to
adjust fees based upon changes to the Engineering News Record Construction Cost Index (ENR
CCI), which, from July 2012 to July 2013, was 3.40%.
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED that the Water and Sewer Connection Fees,
System Development Fees, Pump Station Development Fees, and Related Fees rate schedule will
be adjusted by approximately 3.4% or as noted.
